units.source_text: 天色渐明，烟霞之间露出种种花木，生趣蓬勃，春景毕竟是牵惹人心的。

en.t: The sky gradually grew light, and among the mist and rosy clouds all kinds of flowers and trees appeared, full of living vigor; after all, the scenery of spring has a way of stirring the heart.

units.source_text: 百鸟千种鸣啭，美音不亚于笛。

en.t: Countless birds sang in every variety of voice, their beautiful notes no less lovely than flutes.
Feelings of sorrow and delight reached their height here.

units.source_text: 此时奏出《陵王》舞曲，曲终声调转急，异常繁华热闹。

en.t: At this moment the dance music of Ling Wang was performed; toward the end the tune quickened, becoming extraordinarily splendid and lively.

units.source_text: 诸人都从身上脱下衣袍，赏赐舞人、乐人，彩色缤纷，在此时看来更饶佳趣。

en.t: Everyone took off robes from their own persons and bestowed them on the dancers and musicians; the profusion of colors seemed, at that moment, to add still more charm.

units.source_text: 诸亲王及公侯中长于音乐、舞蹈者，尽量施展技能。

en.t: Among the princes, nobles, and courtiers, those skilled in music and dance displayed their talents to the fullest.

units.source_text: 在座诸人，不问身份高下，无不兴致勃发。

en.t: All those present, regardless of high or low rank, were filled with rising enthusiasm.

units.source_text: 紫夫人观此情景，自念余命无多，不禁悲从中来，但觉万事都可使她伤心。

en.t: Lady Murasaki looked upon this scene and, thinking that little of her life remained, could not keep sorrow from welling up within her; she felt that everything in the world could wound her heart.
